title: Hold a service provider's licence for stevedoring in a port
what: Provide stevedoring (and towage, line boat, bunkering or mooring) services in a WA port only under a service provider's licence from the port authority that runs the port.

sources.title: Port Authorities Regulations 2001 (WA)
sources.locator: Sch 1 cl 5A (Port of Albany; the same duty is in cll 5U, 24, 33, 60, 64E, 95, 106A and 110A for the other ports) (current version (mrdoc_49760), read 25 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: a person must not provide a towage service, line boat service, bunkering service, stevedoring service, mooring service, transport service, bulk handling service or fish handling service in the port except — (a) under the authority of a service provider’s licence issued by the port authority;

sources.title: Port Authorities Regulations 2001 (WA)
sources.locator: Sch 1 cl 95 (Port of Fremantle) (current version (mrdoc_49760), read 25 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: a person must not provide in the port a service listed in subclause (2) except — (a) under the authority of a service provider’s licence issued by the port authority;

administration.who: Port authority that controls and manages the port (WA)

sources.title: Port Authorities Regulations 2001 (WA)
sources.locator: r 3, def port authority, words naming the body (found 25 Nov 2026) (current version (mrdoc_49760), read 25 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: port authority, in relation to a port, means the port authority that controls and manages the port;
